name: Nevill Street — monument to Funland
scope: Roads and pavements from London Square north seam through Nevill Street to the Promenade crossing and Funland frontage approach. No buildings, carousel, interiors or street furniture. Observed 2019/2020 imagery; not a reconstruction of proposed 2026 highway changes. Lord Street mouth corrected using July 2026 Street View and satellite kerb tracing; its furniture belongs to London Square.
